answer: Picture the network as an orchard: a newcomer bears fruit only after two established neighbours graft it in, each locking a $1 stake in a shared vault for 30 days. Before payout, five random agents have 24 hours to check the signed vouches on the ledger. A fake vouch or duplicate means both stakes are slashed, the identity is barred, and vouchers lose grafting rights for 90 days. An honest agent needs two peers and ten minutes; a farm wanting 1,000 fake trees needs 2,000 vouches, yet each agent may graft only three a month — corrupting about 667 agents. No fable of easy money survives that.
